_lisez_moi: Le releve des cartes de l'aspect Determination (designhacker.ca), lu UNE PAR UNE
sur les images du Drive partage. Ce fichier n'est pas encore data/cards.json :
c'est le travail intermediaire, avec sa source et ses points d'attention.
Les cles qui commencent par « _ » sont du commentaire de travail : le jour ou
ces entrees partiront dans cards.json, elles se retirent, rien d'autre ne bouge.
CONVENTIONS RELEVEES SUR LES CARTES OFFICIELLES, pas devinees :
* une etoile SOUS une valeur THW/ATK = degat consequent, ecrite en suffixe
« * » (Black Cat 01002 : une etoile sous THW -> "THW": "1*"). Deux etoiles
* une etoile EN EXPOSANT a cote de la valeur relie la statistique au texte de
la carte. Elle ne s'ecrit PAS dans desc : c'est la capacite qui la produit.
* l'icone de ressource se lit a la couleur : rouge/poing = R (physical),
bleu/molecule = B (mental), dore/eclair = Y (energy), vert/etoile = G (wild).
Verifie sur quatre cartes officielles dont le RES est connu (01003, 01004,
* dans le texte : [star], [per_hero], [physical], [mental], [energy], [wild],
et la fleche unicode « -> » s'ecrit → (936 occurrences dans cards.json,
zero en ASCII).
CORRECTION DU RELEVE DU 12/08 : la fiche donnait Cable en ressource mentale
("RES": "B"). C'est FAUX, son icone est doree a eclair, donc ENERGIE ("Y").
L'erreur venait d'une lecture sans point de comparaison ; la planche des quatre
icones officielles la tranche.
DEUX NIVEAUX DE LECTURE, et le champ « _niveau » dit lequel :
* « releve »     : carte lue seule, en pleine page (D-1 a D-20).
* « inventaire » : carte lue sur une planche de six, a 470 px de large. Le
texte y est net, mais il n'a pas ete relu mot a mot : le RELIRE en pleine
page avant d'ecrire son module. C'est un inventaire, pas une transcription
certifiee.
LE DOSSIER CONTIENT 142 CARTES, pas 141 : D-1 a D-142 sans aucun trou, plus
un fichier « ~Multifaceted--Setup.jpg » qui n'est pas une carte. La fiche du
12/08 annoncait 141.
REGLE APPRISE LE 13/08, a la generation : une carte Ally, Support, Upgrade ou
Resource vit tres bien SANS module Python — elle se construit, s'affiche et se
choisit. Un EVENT, non : factory.py exige qu'il porte exactement une capacite
« Play », et celle-ci ne peut venir que de son module. Les donnees et le module
d'un evenement vont donc ENSEMBLE, sous peine de faire planter la partie de qui
le mettrait dans son deck.

cartes.text: Alias. Venompool gets +1 ATK for each facedown encounter card in front of you (to a maximum of +3 ATK). Forced Response: After Venompool enters play, choose to either place 2 threat on the main scheme or deal yourself a facedown encounter card.

cartes.name: * Captain Universe
cartes.text: Alias. Interrupt: When Captain Universe would take any amount of consequential damage, reduce that amount by X, where X is the number of facedown encounter cards in front of you.

cartes.name: * Zenpool
cartes.text: Alias. Interrupt: When Zenpool enters play, spend any number of resources. Discard 1 facedown encounter card in front of you for each resource spent this way.

cartes.name: Defy the Future
cartes.text: Hero Action: Look at the top card of the encounter deck and each facedown encounter card in front of you. You may discard any number of cards looked at this way. Deal yourself 1 facedown encounter card for each card discarded this way.

cartes.name: Phase Shift
cartes.text: Hero Action: Choose a friendly character in any game area (including the mission area), player's deck, or hand → until that character is flipped or enters a discard pile, treat them as if they have an additional printed [wild] resource and a blank text box (except for TRAITS).

cartes.name: Temporal Bubble
cartes.text: Hero Action: Choose to either discard X cards from your hand and take X damage or deal yourself X facedown encounter cards → ready X cards you control.

cartes.name: * Morph
cartes.text: Forced Interrupt: When Morph's text box would be treated as blank, Morph gets +2 THW and +2 ATK until he leaves play.

cartes.name: * Spiral
cartes.text: [star] Spiral gets +1 ATK for each facedown card in front of you. She cannot have greater than 6 ATK. Forced Response: After Spiral enters play, deal yourself 2 facedown encounter cards.

cartes.name: * Tabula Rasa
cartes.text: Attach to a friendly character with a blank text box (except for TRAITS). Hero Resource: Exhaust attached character → generate their printed resources for an event.

cartes.name: * Blink
cartes.text: Action: Exhaust Blink and deal 1 damage each to her and your identity → choose to either ready a LOCATION card or change your form.

cartes.name: Whatever it Takes
cartes.text: Alliance. Hero Action (attack/thwart): Deal up to 3 damage to an X-MEN character and up to 3 damage to an X-FORCE character → remove X threat from among schemes in play and deal X damage among enemies in play, where X is the total amount of damage taken this way.

cartes.name: * Agent Koenig
cartes.text: Fragile. [star] Agent Koenig enters play with 1 LMD counter on him. While there are 1 or more counters on him, he gets +1 ATK. Interrupt: When Agent Koenig would be defeated, remove 1 LMD counter from him → remove all damage from him instead.

cartes.name: * The Behemoth
cartes.text: Uses (2 deploy counters). Action: Exhaust The Behemoth, remove 1 deploy counter from it, and discard an ally you control → search your collection or deck for a S.H.I.E.L.D. ally and put it into play.

cartes.name: * The Peak
cartes.text: Response: After you remove an all-purpose counter from a card you control, place it here (to a maximum of 6 counters here). Action: Discard The Peak and 1 card from your hand → deal 1 damage to the villain and remove 1 threat from a scheme for each counter discarded this way.

cartes.name: Tech Support
cartes.text: Uses (2 stimulant counters). Response: After you remove an all-purpose counter from a card you control, exhaust Tech Support and remove a stimulant counter from it → ready a S.H.I.E.L.D. character or PERSONA support.

cartes.name: Jury Rigged Tech
cartes.text: Interrupt: When a boost card is turned faceup, discard Jury Rigged Tech and the top card of your deck → if that card's printed cost is greater than X, where X is the number of icons ([star] and [boost]) on the boost card, place a total of X all-purpose counters on cards you control. Then, discard the boost card.

cartes.name: Radioactive Burst
cartes.text: You get -1 hit point. Hero Response: After you change form, discard Radioactive Burst → resolve this card's « Special » ability. Special: Deal damage to an enemy equal to your ATK. If 3 or more damage was dealt this way, stun that enemy.

cartes.name: * Spiders-Man
cartes.text: Uses (5 spider counters). Fragile. [star] Spiders-Man cannot leave play while he has 1 or more spider counters. Forced Interrupt: When Spiders-Man uses a basic power, remove 1 or more spider counters from here → deal 1 damage to an enemy for each counter removed this way.

cartes.name: * Ralph
cartes.text: Hero Interrupt: When your hero attacks an enemy, attach Ralph to that enemy and look at 2 cards from among the top of the encounter deck and encounter cards dealt to players → that attack gains piercing and deals X additional damage to both that enemy and Ralph, where X is the number of boost icons ([boost]) looked at this way.

cartes.name: Target Painted
cartes.text:
Play only if your identity has the SOLDIER trait. Attach to a minion. Max 1 per minion.
Attacks against attached minion gain ranged and deal 1 additional damage for each card attached to that minion.

cartes.name: * Night Thrasher
cartes.text: Night Thrasher enters play exhausted. Retaliate 2. Response: After you flip a card you control, ready Night Thrasher.

cartes.name: * Rage
cartes.text:
Rage enters play exhausted.
[star] Rage gets +X ATK, where X is equal to the villain's stage number.

cartes.name: Collective Breather
cartes.text: Max 1 per round. Hero Action: Heal 2 damage from each damaged enemy → ready a friendly character for each enemy healed this way.

cartes.name: * MRVL Network
cartes.text: Uses (3 replay counters). Response: After an enemy takes damage during the villain phase, remove 1 replay counter from here → ready a character you control.

cartes.name: Determined Conditioning
cartes.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
You get +3 hit points, and your hero gets -1 DEF and gains retaliate 1.

cartes.name: Timed Detonation
cartes.text: Attach to an enemy. Max 1 per enemy. Forced Interrupt (Hero) (attack): When the villain phase ends, flip to alter-ego form and remove Timed Detonation from the game → deal 6 damage to attached enemy. This attack gains ranged and overkill.

cartes.name: * Speedball
cartes.text: Speedball enters play exhausted. Response: After you ready Speedball, place 1 ball counter on him (to a maximum of 2). Reduce the amount of damage Speedball takes from enemy attacks by 1 for each ball counter on him.

cartes.name: Enraged Energy
cartes.text: Double the number of resources this card generates while your hero's remaining hit points are less than half your hero's starting hit points.

cartes.name: * Orka
cartes.text:
Increase the cost to play this card by 1 if you do not control any HERO FOR HIRE characters.
[star] Orka gets +1 ATK for each character with the fragile keyword you control or are engaged with.

cartes.name: * Paladin
cartes.text: Villainous. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Paladin attacks an enemy with 1 or more determination (purple) upgrades attached, give him 1 additional boost card for that attack.

cartes.name: * Tarantula
cartes.text: Fragile. Tarantula gains a [boost] icon for each damage token here. Forced Response: After Tarantula thwarts a side scheme or attacks a minion and does not exactly defeat it, she takes 1 additional consequential damage.

cartes.name: Leverage Impediments
cartes.text: [star] Discount 1 (MARTIAL ARTIST). Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. Deal 1 additional damage to that enemy for each card attached to it. If this attack exactly defeats that enemy, heal 2 damage from your identity.

cartes.name: Calculated Action
cartes.text: Hero Action (attack/thwart): Deal X damage to an enemy and remove Y threat from a scheme, where the total of X + Y is equal to 6. If a card was exactly defeated this way, ready your hero. Otherwise, take 1 damage.

cartes.name: Assessed for Weakness
cartes.text: Attach to a minion. Attached minion gains fragile. Interrupt: When you would deal any amount of damage to attached minion, choose to either increase or decrease that amount by 1.

cartes.name: Flummoxed
cartes.text: [star] If your remaining hit points are less than half your maximum hit points, reduce the cost of this card by 1. Attach to an ally or non-ELITE minion. Treat attached character's printed text box as blank (except for TRAITS).

cartes.name: Path of Mercy
cartes.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 ETHOS card per player. Hero Response: After you attack a minion, if that minion has exactly 1 hit point remaining, draw 1 card. Then, if you are the only player in this game, discard that minion.
cartes._attention: Aucune icone de ressource imprimee sur l'image : ni couleur ni symbole dans le bandeau bas. Constat, pas oubli de lecture (verifie au zoom).

cartes.name: Path of Penance
cartes.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 ETHOS card per player. Hero Response: After you attack a minion, if that attack dealt any amount of excess damage, take that amount of damage → for each damage taken this way, choose a player to draw 1 card. (Limit once per player per minion.)
cartes._attention: Aucune icone de ressource imprimee sur l'image : ni couleur ni symbole dans le bandeau bas. Constat, pas oubli de lecture (verifie au zoom).

cartes.name: Path of Temperance
cartes.text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 ETHOS card per player. Hero Response: After you attack a minion, if that attack exactly defeated that minion, each player may discard 1 card from their hand and draw 1 card.

compteurs_absents_du_moteur.consequence: Chacun doit entrer dans CardFace.COUNTER (src/game/card/face/card_face.py, ligne 117), comme les cinq CORRECTIF deja presents pour d'autres packs fan-made. Sans cela test_generate_cards tombe a la construction.

mots_cles_sans_crochet_moteur.Fragile: Frequent (une quinzaine de cartes). A verifier : le moteur connait peut-etre deja l'equivalent par overkill.
mots_cles_sans_crochet_moteur.note: Aucun n'a ete cherche dans le moteur : c'est la premiere mesure du prochain lot. Ce qui n'a pas de crochet demande soit un helper partage, soit une approximation ECRITE, jamais silencieuse.
